channel.title: whykusanagi blog
channel.description: Streams, digital art, NIKKE tools, the corrupted-theme design system, and Celeste.

item.title: Celeste CLI v1.13.0: MCP, Both Directions
item.description: Celeste CLI v1.13.0 adds `celeste mcp install` (Celeste writes herself into Claude Desktop, Cursor, and Claude Code), a runtime /mcp panel, a native Streamable-HTTP transport, foreign config discovery, the model-callable ask tool, and a rebuilt TUI status line.

item.title: Corrupted Theme 0.3.0: one home for the glitch libraries, deterministic render-to-video, and an LLM-readable surface
item.description: Corrupted Theme 0.3.0 consolidates the glitch libraries scattered across my projects into one canonical package, adds deterministic render-to-video, and ships a machine-readable manifest for LLM agents.

item.title: LDPlayer Part 2 — Inside the Bundle
item.description: Twelve days after the LD Cloud disclosure: buckets closed, operator silent, software unchanged, and a bundled analytics SDK has documented broken encryption.

item.title: LDPlayer & LD Cloud Exposure — Security Advisory
item.description: What I confirmed about LD Cloud, LDPlayer and LDShop exposure, why it is structurally different from a routine leak, and what viewers should do tonight.

item.title: Celeste CLI v1.11.2: Config Profiles Stick, and /model Stops Lying
item.description: Celeste CLI v1.11.2 makes -config profiles work in read commands and lists real provider models in the TUI /model picker. Plus a recap of the 1.11.x Fugu arc.

item.title: Fugu vs Grok: Benchmarking Sakana AI in Celeste CLI v1.11.2
item.description: I added Sakana AI's Fugu model to celeste-cli and ran it head-to-head against Grok on ten reasoning problems and a dependency-DAG subagent relay. Fugu won 10 to 8, drove the DAG cleanly where Grok ran flaky, and is now the default model.

item.title: I Built My Own Task Manager Instead of Opening Obsidian
item.description: CelesteOps is a local-first macOS control panel that shares one SQLite backlog with Claude, Codex, and Cursor over MCP — specs out of git, paired clients, signed releases.

item.title: Corrupted Theme 0.2.1: 14 new components, a real CDN, and security hardening
item.description: Corrupted Theme 0.2.1 ships 14 new components, same-origin CDN distribution with SRI, a canonical data layer for cross-language consumers, a live demo site, and a CodeQL-driven security pass. A glassmorphic dark-mode design system built for production.

item.title: Celeste CLI v1.8: Grimoire Config, Code Graph, MCP Server, and Agentic AI
item.description: Celeste CLI v1.8 brings .grimoire project context, semantic code search, MCP server mode, session persistence, file checkpointing, extended thinking, cost tracking, and plan mode. Open-source Go CLI.
